format: carousel copy only after creator concept approval

stage_scene_beats.story_job: Establish the tiny bid before it looks important.
stage_scene_beats.scene: Aachu notices something small in the room or on her phone and calls for attention with casual urgency.
stage_scene_beats.action_reaction: She leans in with the object; Zuv is mid-task, not ignoring her but not yet inside her moment.
stage_scene_beats.eye_line_hands_distance_object: Her eyes are on the tiny thing, then on him. One hand holds the object toward him. His hand is still near his task.
stage_scene_beats.silence_consequence: The viewer sees the bid before the word 'bid' is ever needed.

stage_scene_beats.story_job: Show turning toward as physical action.
stage_scene_beats.scene: Zuv pauses and turns his upper body toward the object and then toward her face.
stage_scene_beats.action_reaction: He does not perform a grand response; he simply joins the tiny moment fully.
stage_scene_beats.eye_line_hands_distance_object: His eyes follow the object, then return to her. His hand stops moving. The distance closes slightly.
stage_scene_beats.silence_consequence: The small thing becomes shared, which earns the next swipe.

stage_scene_beats.scene: Aachu registers that he actually looked, not just said 'hmm.'
stage_scene_beats.action_reaction: Her expression softens or becomes playfully satisfied. He is amused, present, and not superior.
stage_scene_beats.eye_line_hands_distance_object: The object can fall lower in frame while their eye-line carries the feeling.
stage_scene_beats.silence_consequence: The relationship truth appears: she was not only showing the thing; she was asking to be joined.

stage_scene_beats.story_job: Repair one-way care into mutual rhythm.
stage_scene_beats.scene: Later, Zuv makes a tiny bid of his own: pointing out a detail, offering a taste, or showing a small discovery.
stage_scene_beats.action_reaction: Aachu turns toward him with the same full attention, playful but sincere.
stage_scene_beats.eye_line_hands_distance_object: His hand now holds or points to the object. Her body angle shifts toward him.
stage_scene_beats.silence_consequence: The pattern becomes mutual, not a patient-husband template.

stage_scene_beats.story_job: Earn the tender thesis without a quote-card ending.
stage_scene_beats.scene: The two tiny turns leave them close in an ordinary room, with the original objects now secondary.
stage_scene_beats.action_reaction: No speech needed. Their posture shows that the relationship is built from repeated small returns.
stage_scene_beats.eye_line_hands_distance_object: Hands are relaxed, bodies angled inward, objects quiet in the lower frame.
stage_scene_beats.silence_consequence: The viewer can understand the carousel even if all text is hidden.
